listings.d: 10Yes RV Solutions is a mobile RV service based in Medina, Ohio, running a roughly 100-mile radius that includes Cleveland and Akron. It handles Schwintek slides, hydraulic and electric leveling systems, AC units, furnaces, water heaters and RV refrigerators, plus electrical upgrades, solar, inverters, battery systems and accurate tank level systems. It also does spring wheel bearing and brake service and suspension upgrades, and is an authorized SeeLevel Tank Sensors dealer and installer.

evidence.type_quote: We Come to You!!
coverage_quotes: We are located in Medina Ohio and service ≈ 100 mile radius, including Cleveland, Akron and surrounding areas.

listings.d: Switching Lane's RV Services is a one-man mobile RV repair business based on the northeast side of Ohio. The owner is a certified RV technician (National RV Training Academy) who comes to the customer's home or campsite to diagnose and repair RV systems, covering Summit, Stark, Wayne, Medina, Portage, Geauga, Cuyahoga, Mahoning and Trumbull counties. He does campsite temporary emergency repairs and orders special-order parts with pre-payment.

evidence.type_quote: I Specialize in mobile RV repairs.
evidence.emergency_quote: I also do campsite temporary emergency repairs, to help get you back home safely.
coverage_quotes: When I'm not travelling across this great country of ours, I can be found in the Northeast side of Ohio.
Serving Summit, Stark, Wayne, Medina, Portage, Geauga, Cuyahoga, Mahoning, Trumbull counties.

listings.d: Northern Mobile Electric is a Canton shop at 1818 Hopple Ave. SW that does camper, motorhome, RV and bus repair on both the house side and the chassis. House-side work includes rooftop and other air conditioning, heaters, appliances, lights, transfer switches, power centers, solar panels, inverters, batteries, steps, awnings, slide toppers and generators. Chassis work includes engine service and repair, brakes, lighting and charging-system repair. The business has operated since 1980 and is a member of the Electrical Rebuilders Association.

evidence.type_quote: Camper, motorhome, RV and Bus - House side services, repairs and/or replacement
coverage_quotes: Trailer, Motorhome, RV, and Bus Chassis Repairs

listings.d: A&M Mobile Repair is a mobile-only RV and motorhome repair service based in Youngstown, Ohio, working within a 120-mile radius that reaches Akron, Cleveland and Canton. It handles roof, plumbing and seal leaks, electrical failures with batteries, alternators and wiring, brake and suspension problems, engine performance and overheating, and exterior or body repair. The owner holds a Master ASE certification and speaks with customers directly.

evidence.type_quote: When you need reliable RV repair, A&M Mobile Repair brings professional service directly to you—anytime, anywhere.
evidence.emergency_quote: Call 330-503-1372 today for trusted mobile RV repair service you can count on, available 24/7.
evidence.roadside_quote: This includes roadside assistance for breakdowns and scheduled service at your yard or jobsite.
coverage_quotes: As well as Youngstown, OH, we also proudly service Akron, OH; Cleveland, OH; Canton, OH; Wheeling, OH; Pittsburgh, PA; Erie, PA; Johnstown, PA; Jamestown, NY; Morgantown, OH; Greensburg, PA; and Indiana, PA.

listings.d: Sabetti Body Shop is a collision and body repair facility at 358 North Francis Street in Kent that has operated for over 45 years. Alongside auto collision work it lists truck and RV/motorhome damage among its services, and it does computerized wheel alignment and frame correction. It serves Kent and the surrounding Summit and Portage County communities of Stow, Hudson, Cuyahoga Falls, Munroe Falls, Tallmadge, Streetsboro and Ravenna.

evidence.type_quote: We repair ALL makes and models, offer FREE estimates, work with ALL insurance companies, and offer LIFETIME warranty on repairs as long as you own the vehicle (excluding rust repairs).
coverage_quotes: Sabetti Body Shop is a locally owned and operated facility that has been repairing cars in Kent and surrounding Summit and Portage County communities of Stow, Hudson, Cuyahoga Falls, Munroe Falls, Tallmadge, Streetsboro and Ravenna for over 45 years.

listings.d: Ruff's RV Center is an RV dealership with full sales, service and parts departments located at 140 Blackbrook Rd in Painesville Township. It carries new and pre-owned motorhomes and trailers from brands including Heritage Glen, Wildwood, Rockwood, Wildwood X-Lite and Roo, and its service department handles ongoing maintenance and customization. It serves the Cleveland area, including Euclid, Willoughby, Mentor and surrounding Lake County communities.

evidence.type_quote: Ruff's RV Center has full sales, service and parts departments with knowledgeable and experienced staff to accommodate your needs.
coverage_quotes: Ruff's RV Center is conveniently located near the areas of Cleveland, Pittsburgh, Erie and Akron.

listings.d: Camping World RV Service - Akron is the service center of the Camping World dealership at 1005 Interstate Pkwy in Akron. It performs annual maintenance and multi-point inspections, OE and extended warranty work, appliance service (AC, furnaces, water heaters, refrigerators), electrical and plumbing diagnostics, roof inspection/resealing/replacement, winterization and de-winterization, plus performance installations and collision repair. It also offers a mobile service that travels to the customer's location for diagnostics and on-site repairs.

evidence.type_quote: Your RV deserves expert care, and at Camping World of Akron we deliver exactly that.
coverage_quotes: Situated in the heart of the Ohio & Erie Canalway region, just south of Cleveland, our service center is easily reachable via I-76 and I-77 for RV owners from Cleveland, Canton, Youngstown, and Medina.

listings.d: Post's Traveland is an RV service, parts and storage shop at 4145 Westerville Road in Columbus, family-run in Central Ohio since 1956. Service, parts and storage are all handled in one location.

listings.d: Blue Compass RV Columbus is an RV dealership and service center at 5742 OH-37 in Delaware, at the north end of the Columbus metro. The service center handles routine maintenance and major repairs including engine/transmission and chassis, electrical and solar, plumbing and water systems, HVAC, appliances, roof and exterior, slide-outs, collision/body work and warranty/recall assistance, and every vehicle gets a free multi-point inspection. It serves Columbus, Delaware County and surrounding Central Ohio.

listings.d: Wendell's Garage is a motorhome and RV repair shop in Delaware, Ohio, staffed by ASE-certified technicians. It serves motorhome owners throughout Delaware and surrounding counties.

coverage_quotes: Turn to the professionals at Wendell’s Garage in Delaware, Ohio, serving motorhome owners throughout Delaware and surrounding counties, including customers in Delaware, Lewis Center, Powell, Sunbury, Galena, Westerville, Ostrander, Radnor, Marysville, Richwood, Prospect and Waldo.

listings.d: All State RV Repair is a mobile RV repair business operating out of Columbus, Ohio, bringing repairs and maintenance to the customer's location. It also sells a selection of camping and outdoor products.

evidence.type_quote: We provide dependable mobile RV repair services by bringing professional repairs and maintenance directly to your location, saving you time and getting you back to enjoying the outdoors.
coverage_quotes: I offer reliable mobile RV repair services, from Columbus, OH to Charleston, WV, and over to Morgantown, WV, ensuring your camper receives the attention it needs wherever you are.

evidence.type_quote: Longship RV provides expert mobile repair services directly to your campsite or driveway, ensuring your vacation stays on track.
